worked_solution:
The formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r}$ is given by

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\,.
$$

$P(15,4)$ means the same thing as ${}_{15}{P}_{4}.$ Using the usual formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}P(15,4) & =\frac{15!}{(15-4)!} \\  & =\frac{15!}{11!} \\  & =\frac{15\cdot 14\cdot 13\cdot 12\cdot \cancel{11!}}{\cancel{11!}} \\  & =15\cdot 14\cdot 13\cdot 12 \\  & =32\,760.\end{aligned}
$$
